shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated geometric pattern (chevron/zigzag or beaded band)
a frontal anthropomorphic figure with outstretched arms (implied in the pillar's carved arms/figure, explicit in A)
justification: Both surfaces show an anthropomorphic frontal presence combined with animal forms and a horizontal band of repeated geometric ornament, but these are generic correspondences any tradition could produce independently. A is a single dominant, brightly infilled masked figure with weapons in both hands and pendant trophies, while B is a stacked composition of repeated animal heads, a chevron band and separate low-relief quadrupeds, birds and serpents with no comparable weapon-bearing central actor.
